blocks.text: Applications such as Notepad and Microsoft Word use a stack for undo. Each action, such as typing or deleting text, is pushed onto a stack. Pressing undo pops the most recent action and reverses it; pressing again reverses the one before. If you typed 'Hello' and then 'World', undo removes 'World' first and then 'Hello'.
